# Lemmings On Damen

> Cozy Bucktown tavern on Damen with free pool, pinball, craft beer, local art and room for parties. Rated 4.5 from 224 Google reviews.

- Type: Bar
- Address: 1850 N Damen Ave 2ND FL, Chicago, IL 60647, USA
- Phone: (773) 862-1688

## About
Afternoons and evenings, we pour strong drinks and trade friendly words with anyone who stops in. It's a vintage tavern with a carved bar, worn wood, low lighting and local art on the walls.
There's pinball, free pool, craft beer and drink specials on school nights. We have plenty of room when you bring a crowd, and we're happy to host your party. Neighbors have given us 4.5 stars across 224 Google reviews.

## Services
- Free pool all night: Bring some friends and play pool all night long without paying for it.
- Pinball: Pinball machines are always here, right alongside the pool table.
- Sunday night open mic: Our Sunday night open mic is a regular event, along with pinball tournaments and more.
- School night specials: Weekly drink specials Sunday through Thursday, with something for all tastes.
- Private parties and events: Planning a private party or other casual event? It's easy and usually free. Send us a message and we'll get back to you fast.

## FAQ
Q: Do you serve food?
A: No, we don't serve food. We focus on drinks, games and good company.

Q: Can I host a party at Lemmings?
A: Yes. We have plenty of room for large groups and parties. Send us a message for details.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Damen Ave in Bucktown, steps from the heart of Wicker Park. One reviewer noted it's within walking distance of major transit.

## What customers say
- "All of the bartenders are attractive and personable. The doormen are suave and handsome. The drinks are personalized to your taste and sensibility. The location is within walking distance of major transit. 10/10 would go again." (Allison Raines (sacredspheres), 5/5)
- "Perfect little neighborhood bar. Stopped in on a Saturday and the bartender was super friendly. Interesting draft beer menu." (Ashleigh Mavros, 5/5)
- "Had a good time on Sunday going back to test the pool table next time. Nice vibe and great service." (Brian Kipngetich, 5/5)
- "This bar doesn't serve food. Service and drinks were great!" (Al Dent, 5/5)
- "…and the worn wood and low lighting really made it feel like a proper escape from the downpour outside. Plenty of room to spread out too, which was great since there were several of us. It did get a bit noisy later on, but that's to be expected." (Cristobal, 4/5)
